name: Canadian Red Ensign

flag.description: A red field with the Union Jack in the canton and, in the fly, the shield of Canada: the royal arms of England, Scotland, Ireland and France above a sprig of three red maple leaves on white.
flag.symbolism: The shield combines the arms of England, Scotland and Ireland with the fleurs-de-lis of royal France, for Canada's founding peoples, and maple leaves for Canada itself.

hook: Before the Maple Leaf, Canada flew a British red ensign: the Union Jack in the corner and the Canadian shield, with three red maple leaves at its foot, in the fly.
trivia: Canada flew versions of the Red Ensign from the late 19th century; the 1957 version changed the maple leaves on the shield from green to red.
After the Great Flag Debate of 1964, the Maple Leaf flag replaced the Red Ensign on 15 February 1965.
